central_question: Did an early coordinated or managed persona layer create apparently spontaneous celebrity replies/social proof that later caused genuine independent users to imitate the behavior, converting managed seeding into organic recommendation-driven amplification?

primary_test.interpretation: Strong support for seeding-to-organic-cascade if early high-impact interaction partners share hidden management/infrastructure while later imitators are predominantly independent genuine users.
primary_test.negative_control: Both early and late cohorts are independent and match ordinary celebrity virality controls.

platform_side_checks_requested: Instagram-Threads-Accounts Center provenance and management relationships
payment/advertising relationships relevant to the engagement wave
rare repeated interaction templates and synchronized timing
recommendation/discovery exposure before and after celebrity replies
enforcement-history overlap with previously disrupted influence networks
recurring first-wave persona partners across multiple celebrity anchors

youth_coded_persona_layer.reason_for_inclusion: Persona presentation plus peer-reviewed parasocial/digital-super-peer mechanism makes age/audience integrity worth platform-side checking if coordination exists.

precedent_class_included: Meta-documented Russia-linked coordinated inauthentic behavior using fake personas and lifestyle/celebrity/entertainment audience building
Meta-documented fictitious-persona network targeting Ukraine in 2022
DOJ-documented Russian government-backed AI-enhanced bot farm using fictitious personas
political_context_rule: Political/war alignment of celebrity anchors is secondary significance only and is not an enforcement basis. It becomes analytically relevant only if Meta independently establishes hidden coordination/deceptive amplification.
falsification_contract: Independent authentic early users with unrelated histories weaken the hypothesis.
No meaningful shared management/device/network/recovery/contractor/payment/business links weaken the hypothesis.
Normal celebrity virality timing/recommendation behavior weakens the hypothesis.
No recurring first-wave persona cluster across anchors weakens the hypothesis.
Shared early operators/infrastructure followed by predominantly independent late users strengthens the hypothesis.
freeze_rule: Do not silently broaden Meta v4 with network-control or state-attribution claims. Any material new platform evidence after this freeze must be recorded as a new annex or superseding revision before submission.
